newsitem.title: UK: Nthn Ireland Elec up as BZW upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Nthn Ireland Elec up as BZW upgrades.

text.p: Shares in Northern Ireland Electricity Plc rose on Wednesday as analysts at BZW raised their rating on the stock to "buy" from "hold," market sources said.
The stock was up 8-1/2p at 405 by 0917 GMT, in volume of 734,792 shares, after earlier setting a nine-month high of 409p.
Sources said BZW's upgrade reflected hopes for NIE's joint venture with United Utilities Plc's Vertex subsidiary, aimed at building a facilities management business covering the whole of Ireland.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
